text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Takarazuka Kinen brings
the spring GⅠ season to a close!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And so, while it might be a bit early, let's look back on this season.
First and foremost, these two!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Duramente and Satono Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: You can't talk about this season without mentioning these two. The Derby in particular left a profound impression.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san utilized her tremendous legs, while Satono Crown-san relied on intellect and calculation... Both brought out their utmost strengths in that race.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"The tension was incredible because of that, wasn't it?!
I couldn't take my eyes off it until the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, aren't you going to eat?
Are you feeling down?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ! N-No, no! I'll eat it~ I'll eat it! I'll totally eat it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Aaah. Another Duramente special, huh~?
Well, she was amazing in the Derby, after all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...We were running in that race too, you know...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: One, two... three, four...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ehh~~!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Duramente isn't participating in
today's public training session~?!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's your fault for not keeping up.
Still, there's plenty of highlights, right? Look, next to Gold Ship. Even that fine young lady over there--

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...! Not listening, not listening!! Eavesdropping is a waste of time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: All I gotta do now is focus! All right!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —...Ngh, I've gotta do my best.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —There was a star I looked up to.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That Umamusume was always the number-one favorite
in both the Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby.
She was so dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...It was so cool.
It was like a dream."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to become like that Umamusume.
Me, too—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Still, the ones carrying everyone's expectations in the Classic—were those two.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...H-How strange.
I've only just started running, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I should still be able to run, and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —...I'm home.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
K-Kita-chan!
B-Big news! Big news!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Six months for full recovery.
Any hope of racing within the year is considered lost."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Repeating our headline. It has been revealed that Duramente,
the Umamusume who electrified this spring season,
has suffered a bone fracture."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "With plans considering both the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe and the Kikuka Sho this autumn, expectations from Umamusume fans were high, leading to widespread disappointment."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...A fracture?
Duramente is—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be away from here for a while.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "If you left anything behind, please let me know. I'll come deliver it to you."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'm sure they'll be right back anyway.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Take care.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, Kura-chan!
What about Duramente-san—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
! Kitasan!
Sorry, she just left a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I-I see.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
! Did you have something to tell her?
She left in the family car, so
she should be able to pick up if you call.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? N-No!
I-It's okay! It wasn't anything important anyway."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um... Kura-chan. Is Duramente-san not going to make it in time for the Kikuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yeah. They said it'll take a while to make a full recovery. She won't make it in time for the Kikuka Sho or the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...I know it's frustrating,
but if you're injured, getting treated has to come first.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
......So, she won't be there.
At the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...If she's not here, then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...I'm okay, Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san will be back soon.
Early next year at the earliest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So the chance to beat her will definitely come!
Don't get discouraged now,
keep giving it your all for yourself!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: For now, I'm adjusting for the Senior Class too, but... Kitasan, you're running in the Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Kitasan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! ...Y-Yeah!
You're right!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Kura-chan is already thinking about
what happens when Duramente-san comes back.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Of course! The stronger the rivals, the more exciting the race gets, right—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...*sniffle*!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry about that. I'll head back to the Miho dorm first. You're heading back to Ritto too, right, Kitasan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"See you, Kitasan!
If there's ever a chance to run together, let me know!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Ha, haha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ――... I'm so uncool.
